Based on the safety profile and positive proof-of-concept findings from Cohort 1, the Company has advanced to the higher-dose Cohort 2, evaluating OPGx-BEST1 at 4.5 x 10⁹ vg/eye, with dosing expected to be complete in the fourth quarter of 2026 and topline three-month data expected to be available in the second quarter of 2027.
